| description = Spawns on the death of a [[tainted seafury cyclops]] , Patch to fix having 2 of them up has been broken . BE WARNED when hunting for this monster .... Pexar 3-7-16

The best way to fight Corrupt Seafury Cyclops is to fear kite them. Will summon if its hit points are  96% or less. Be wary of losing spellcasts due to the water line if it runs into the water, which is nearly guaranteed with its health pool.

When you kill a [[tainted seafury cyclops]] and a Corrupted seafury cyclops spawns immediately afterward, it does not agro to you instantly.
